summary: Scoble expects AI and robots to remake work and daily life, opposes a US pause while China races ahead, and warns about AI in the wrong hands.

statements.quote: Let’s say USA pauses its AI development. Will China? No. Can we afford to fall six months behind?
We are worried about the long term risk. There is a far closer one: infrastructure security.
We will always have work. Even after AGI arrives.
This technology in the wrong hands would harm us all. In good hands it will help all.
And our government is broken and not able to deal with the massive changes to our economy coming.
